Container.Name: vinted-sniper
Container.Overview: Get a message on Discord, Telegram, ntfy or another app the moment a new Vinted listing matches your search. Paste a Vinted search into the dashboard, or build one there. It filters on the price you actually pay (buyer protection included), notices when a search goes quiet, and never logs in to Vinted, so there is no account to put at risk. Not affiliated with Vinted.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: vinted alerts notifier discord telegram secondhand
Container.Requires: Internet access. Discord, Telegram or ntfy for the alerts themselves.

Config.Name: Dashboard port
Config.Description: The web dashboard, where searches and alerts are set up.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database with your searches and alert settings. One small file.

Config.Name: Dashboard password
Config.Description: Strongly recommended: the dashboard can be reached from your whole network and shows your webhook links. Any long random text; you type it once to sign in.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for times in the dashboard and for quiet hours.

Config.Name: Dashboard address for alert links
Config.Description: Optional. How you open the dashboard, for example http://192.168.1.10:8000, so links in alerts lead back to it.

Config.Name: Telegram bot token
Config.Description: Optional, from @BotFather, for Telegram alerts. Discord needs nothing here.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the Data folder (Unraid: 99 = nobody). The app runs as this user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the Data folder (Unraid: 100 = users).
